gen-gf-revalia-gf-jaldi: Jaldi brings a brushed, tightly packed texture with a tall x-height and a visibly gaping c. Jaldi's sans-serif sturdiness is the pair's best trait, set against Revalia's bold, loose-limbed display swagger.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Revalia leads with a bold, expressive stride, its letters spaced widely and its g left open at the bottom. And Kdam Thmor Pro follows in a modern plain sans whose full bowls make a long passage feel dense and steady.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-krona-one: Expressive and loud, Revalia spreads its tall band of letters out with a relaxed stride. Krona One holds a loosely spaced, sans-serif lowercase with the stature of cast iron capitals, so shrinking the heading would let the body take over.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-magra: Magra feels big-bodied in every lowercase word, a plain sans with a professional, level-headed manner. Revalia above it is loud and wide-striding, and made small it would lose that swagger.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-major-mono-display: Revalia strides across the line with bold, widely separated letters and a g that stays open below. Major Mono Display answers in monospace with neon-glass tubing and generous sidebearings, precise where Revalia is expressive.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-martian-mono: Revalia sets bold, expressive letters far apart, with a short-stalked tall band and an open-bellied g. Martian Mono holds the monospace line with compass-pencil consistency.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-matemasie: A lowercase g left open at the bottom marks Revalia, with bold letters set in a relaxed stride. But Matemasie, a plain sans, closes its round letters and spaces its glyphs broadly, so shrinking the heading would erase that difference.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-menbere: Revalia is all bold, expressive display, with widely spaced letters and short stalks. Menbere is a clean, neutral plain sans whose lowercase stacks tall like rolled cord, quiet where the heading is loud.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-mitr: Widely separated letters and a g with an open lower curve make Revalia unmistakable, bold and relaxed in stride. Mitr, a plain sans, keeps x-height close to cap height, so paragraphs feel compact and friendly.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-momo-trust-display: Revalia's open-bellied g and wide, relaxed stride make the heading bold and expressive. Momo Trust Display, a plain sans, lets its generous x-height drift across the line, so paragraphs feel clean and spacious.
